'''Davorak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] who served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he sold items in the Galactic Trade Market section aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />
